products.descriptionShort: DEMCO replacement seats are hard-backed cartridge seats for NE-C, NE-I and NE-D butterfly valves (2–12 in) and NF-C valves (14–24 in), in Buna-N, FKM, EPDM or natural rubber. The size table lists 15 seat numbers, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
DEMCO replacement seats are hard-backed cartridge seats for the NE-C, NE-I and NE-D butterfly valves in 2–12 in and the NF-C in 14–24 in. A demco butterfly valve seat is an elastomer bonded to a rigid backing ring, so it slip-fits into the body and is replaced without special tools.

Which valve it fits

The size table lists 15 seat numbers. NE-C, NE-I and NE-D valves share one seat per size, with one exception: the NE-D 3 in takes 25095. The NF-C seats cover 14, 16, 18, 20 and 24 in. The NF-C seats are for the 14–24 in sizes only.

SizeSeat numberFits

4 in1792-XXXNE-C, NE-I, NE-D

16 in23913-03XNF-C

Reading the seat number

The suffix selects the elastomer: -031 Buna-N, -034 FKM, -135 EPDM (peroxide cured) and -036 natural rubber. On NF-C seats the last digits read 03X for Buna-N and FKM and X35 for EPDM. Limits by elastomer are Buna-N 0 to 180 °F (−18 to 82 °C), EPDM 20 to 275 °F (−6 to 135 °C), FKM 20 to 300 °F (−6 to 149 °C) and natural rubber −30 to 150 °F (−34 to 65 °C). Seats are quoted against the valve series and size, so say which valve the seat is for.

Replacing a seat

Open the valve, remove the handle or actuator, remove the tangential pins, pull the stems and push the disc and seat out. Reassemble with a small amount of non-hydrocarbon lubricant. There are no disc-position precautions at installation, so the seat can be fitted without orienting the disc to it. The same procedure applies from the 2 in seat 1786-XXX to the 24 in NF-C seat 7103-03X.

How to order

Send valve series, size, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Discs are listed under the replacement discs.

faqs.question: How do I choose between Buna-N, EPDM, FKM and natural rubber DEMCO seats?

faqs.question: Do I need to position the disc when fitting a DEMCO butterfly valve seat?

faqs.question: Which DEMCO seat fits the NF-C large-bore valve?

A continuous annular raised band around the stem hole and the disc edge presses flat into the seat at every angle. faqs.question: What is the DEMCO 2-position locking handle made of?

faqs.question: When should I choose -002 corrosion-resistant trim on a DEMCO 2-position handle?

faqs.question: How do I read a DEMCO two-position handle part number such as 24235-001?

faqs.question: Which DEMCO butterfly valves does the 2-position locking handle fit?

faqs.question: DEMCO 2-position handle or 10-position handle: which should I choose?

faqs.question: Can a DEMCO 2-position handle be padlocked?

products.focusKeyword: demco square-nut handle for butterfly valves
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO square-nut operator replaces the lever handle with a 2 in square nut turned by a T-key wrench, for buried, kerb-stop and below-grade butterfly valves from 2 in to 12 in, in three frame sizes, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO square-nut operator replaces the lever handle on a butterfly valve with a 2 in square nut that is turned by a buried-service T-key wrench from grade level. The demco square-nut handle for butterfly valves is an AWWA-style, outdoor-rated operator for buried, kerb-stop and below-grade installations.

Frame sizes and compatibility

The operator comes in three frame sizes: 2–4 in, 5–6 in and 8–12 in, matched to the valve size. It fits any 2–12 in DEMCO butterfly valve in the NE-C, NE-I, NE-I Sanitary, NE-D and NEI-T series, and it mounts on the DEMCO top flange.

Materials and trim

  • Square-nut hub: ductile iron.
  • Throttle plate: steel.
  • Trim: standard only, because buried service does not normally need a corrosion-resistant or sanitary trim.
  • Environment: outdoor-rated, AWWA-style buried-service operator.
  • Supply pressure: not applicable, because the operator is manual.

Operating it

The valve is installed closed between flanges and needs no regular maintenance or lubrication, and the DEMCO top flange is dimensionally compatible with other butterfly valves. The operator is turned by wrench and is wrench-operable across 2–6 in; a gear operator is recommended for 8–12 in. No supply pressure applies, because it is manual. A square nut works at fixed torque only, so for repeatable throttle positions use the memory-stop handle instead.

Typical uses are buried water-distribution mains, kerb-stop isolation valves, below-grade fire-water mains, underground process and utility lines and manhole-access valve installations.

How to order

Send the valve series and size the operator will mount on, plus the environment, through our contact page, and confirm which frame covers it: 2–4 in, 5–6 in or 8–12 in. Standard trim is the only trim, so there is no trim choice to make. Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

The extension is a pass-through. It develops no torque, and the stem material is sized to the valve's rated operating torque, so the operator is chosen for the valve, not for the extension. Extensions are quoted per valve, so give the valve series and size as well as the length.

Typical installations

Tank-bottom valves with grade-level manual operators, buried installations with the operator at grade, valves inside thick insulation or cladding, confined-space valves with operators moved to an accessible point, and mezzanine-floor valves with handle-level operators. High-elevation and below-grade combined installations also use extensions. A square-nut operator can sit on top for buried duty.

How to order

Give the valve series and size, the construction material and the exact length required, in inches or feet, through our contact page. Lengths beyond 16 feet are special order. Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series DR double-acting pneumatic actuator automates NE-C, NE-I, NE-D and NF-C butterfly valves from 2 in to 24 in (50–600 mm). The demco series dr double-acting pneumatic actuator has two opposed pistons with integral gear racks driving a central shaft, and pressure is needed to move the valve in either direction, so it stays in its last position if supply is lost.

Torque by frame size

Supply pressure is 40–120 psi, air or hydraulic. Listed torque output by frame:

FrameTorque output
EDA40620 in-lb @ 120 psi

PDA250035,912 in-lb
PDA400060,623 in-lb

EDA350, EDA950 and the other frames sit between them, at 5,337 and 13,537 in-lb.

Construction and mounting

  • Aluminium body, pistons and end caps; hard-anodised Aluminium Alloy 70-75 central drive shaft.
  • Plated-steel fasteners, Buna-N seals and carbon-filled Teflon guide bands.
  • Flatted stem adapter on 2–12 in valves, keyed stem on 14–24 in.
  • Direct mount through a splined aluminium stem adapter on the most popular sizes, an aluminium adapter plate (closed-coupled) on non-direct sizes, and steel brackets with a coupling kit on the largest valves.
  • Totally enclosed with gaskets; NEMA 4 or NEMA 7 enclosures are available for accessories.

Selecting an actuator

Give the valve series and size, the supply medium, the supply pressure (40, 60, 80, 100 or 120 psi) and the orientation. Indus Hydraulics sizes the actuator against the valve's torque and confirms the model; the part-number suffix encodes valve size, orientation and accessories. For fail-safe duty see the spring-return actuator.

Send the details through our contact page and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Typical duty is process-plant isolation, cooling-water and chilled-water automation, tank-farm batch control and pump-discharge automation.

faqs.question: Which frame sizes and torques does the DEMCO DR double-acting actuator offer?
faqs.answer: The listed frames are EDA40 (620 in-lb @ 120 psi), EDA200 (3,071), EDA350 (5,337), EDA600 (9,069), EDA950 (13,537), EDA1600 (22,379), PDA2500 (35,912) and PDA4000 (60,623 in-lb). Indus Hydraulics matches the frame to the valve torque.

faqs.question: What supply does the DEMCO DR double-acting actuator need?
faqs.answer: It runs on 40–120 psi air or hydraulic supply, and the selection asks for the actual supply pressure, 40, 60, 80, 100 or 120 psi. Double-acting means pressure is needed in both directions, so an EDA600 at 9,069 in-lb needs supply to open and to close.

faqs.question: Which DEMCO valves does the Series DR double-acting actuator fit?
faqs.answer: It fits NE-C, NE-I, NE-D and NF-C valves from 2 in to 24 in (50–600 mm), for example an NF-C at 24 in. The stem is flatted on 2–12 in valves and keyed on 14–24 in, so quote the valve size.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO DR double-acting actuator made of?
faqs.answer: The body, pistons and end caps are aluminium, and the central drive shaft is hard-anodised Aluminium Alloy 70-75. Fasteners are plated steel, seals are Buna-N and the pistons run on carbon-filled Teflon guide bands. The PDA4000 frame uses the same materials as the EDA40.

faqs.question: DEMCO DR double-acting or spring-return actuator: which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Choose double-acting where holding the last position on loss of supply is acceptable, and the [spring-return](/p/demco-series-dr-spring-return-pneumatic-actuator-for-butterfly-valves-2-24) where the valve must go to a set safe position. The double-acting EDA1600 gives 22,379 in-lb.

faqs.question: How is a DEMCO DR double-acting actuator specified for a valve?
faqs.answer: Give the valve series and size, the supply medium, the available supply pressure and the orientation of the flow axis to the actuator body. Indus Hydraulics sizes the actuator against the valve's torque, and the part-number suffix encodes valve size, orientation and accessories.

faqs.question: What enclosure does the DEMCO Series DR actuator have?
faqs.answer: The body is totally enclosed with gaskets, giving a weatherproof construction. NEMA 4 or NEMA 7 enclosures are available for accessories such as switches. A PDA2500 at 35,912 in-lb is enclosed in the same way as an EDA200 at 3,071 in-lb.

faqs.question: How does a DEMCO DR actuator mount on a butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Most popular sizes mount directly through a splined aluminium stem adapter. Non-direct sizes use an aluminium adapter plate (closed-coupled), and the largest valves use steel brackets and a coupling kit. A 12 in valve has a flatted stem and a 20 in valve a keyed stem.

faqs.question: What happens to a DEMCO double-acting actuator if air supply is lost?
faqs.answer: The valve stays in its last position, because pressure on either side of the pistons is what moves it; this is the fail-last-position behaviour. A PDA4000 at 60,623 in-lb behaves the same as an EDA40. For a defined fail position use the spring-return version.

products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series DR spring-return pneumatic actuator automates NE-C, NE-I, NE-D and NF-C butterfly valves from 2 in to 24 in (50–600 mm). The demco series dr spring-return pneumatic actuator moves the valve with air in one direction and with its spring in the other, so on loss of supply air the valve goes to a set position, fail-open or fail-closed. A declutchable manual override can be added.

Torque by frame size

Supply is 40–120 psi air. Listed torque output by frame:

FrameTorque output

ESA950 gives 12,518 in-lb and PSA4004 gives 47,613 in-lb.

Construction

  • Aluminium body, pistons and end caps; hard-anodised drive shaft; plated-steel fasteners; Buna-N seals.
  • Compression springs sized to the application.
  • Direct splined-stem mount on 2–12 in valves and keyed stem on 14–24 in, as on the double-acting actuator.
  • Totally enclosed with gaskets; a declutchable manual override is available from size 40 to 4004, and its handwheel holds the valve in its last position until the actuator returns to automatic.

Typical duty and ordering

Spring sets run 2 to 6 on ESA frames and 8 to 14 on PSA frames, and Indus Hydraulics recommends the set against the valve's torque, so a manual override or a heavier set can be quoted for the same valve. Typical duty is emergency shutdown, fire-water and deluge valves, blow-down and depressurisation valves, process-safety isolation and fail-safe tank-farm and compressor-station block valves. faqs.question: What is the DEMCO Series DR spring-return pneumatic actuator used for?

faqs.question: Which frame sizes and torques does the DEMCO DR spring-return actuator offer?

faqs.question: What air supply does the DEMCO DR spring-return actuator need?
faqs.answer: It runs on 40–120 psi air, and the specification asks for the available pressure at 40, 60, 80, 100 or 120 psi. Air moves the valve in one direction against the spring, so an ESA600 at 8,364 in-lb needs air to stroke and relies on the spring on supply loss.

faqs.question: Which DEMCO valves does the Series DR spring-return actuator fit?
faqs.answer: It fits NE-C, NE-I, NE-D and NF-C valves from 2 in to 24 in (50–600 mm), with a splined stem mount on 2–12 in and a keyed stem on 14–24 in. A 20 in NF-C valve therefore takes the keyed-stem arrangement.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO DR spring-return actuator made of?
faqs.answer: The body, pistons and end caps are aluminium and the drive shaft is hard-anodised. Fasteners are plated steel, seals are Buna-N and the compression spring or springs are sized to the application. The PSA4000 uses the same construction as the ESA40.

faqs.question: DEMCO DR spring-return or double-acting actuator: which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Choose spring-return when loss of air must send the valve to a safe state. Choose the [double-acting actuator](/p/demco-series-dr-double-acting-pneumatic-actuator-for-butterfly-valves-2-24) when holding the last position is acceptable. The spring-return PSA4000 gives 47,613 in-lb.

faqs.question: What do fail-open and fail-closed mean on a DEMCO spring-return actuator?
faqs.answer: Fail-open means the spring opens the valve on loss of supply air, and fail-closed means it closes the valve; the choice is made by the spring orientation when you specify the actuator. State the fail position with the valve size, for example 12 in fail-closed.

faqs.question: Can the DEMCO DR spring-return actuator have a manual override?

faqs.question: Where is the DEMCO spring-return actuator used?

faqs.question: How is a DEMCO DR spring-return actuator specified?
